• Conversation Mode – Hold live discussions with automatic two-way translations that make interactions seamless.

Why Choose Translate AI
• Coverage of 200+ global languages
• AI-powered accuracy with clear pronunciation
• Multiple input methods: text, voice, and camera
• Works online or offline for flexibility
• Simple, intuitive design for everyday use

Translate AI is designed with your privacy in mind. Your translations remain secure while you focus on learning, traveling, working, or connecting worldwide. With AI precision, offline access, and easy design, communication across borders has never been more effortless.

Welcome to Closed Captions (CC), your easy tool for seamless transcription and translation of your surroundings.  

CC was built to create a world where every language becomes your own.  

CC empowers you to effortlessly convert spoken words into accurate text in real-time, facilitating accessibility, communication, and convenience like never before.
With CC, simply stream audio through your device's microphone, and watch as the spoken words magically transform into clear, readable text on your screen. Whether you're attending lectures, participating in meetings, or engaging in conversations, CC ensures that every word is captured with precision, eliminating the need for manual note-taking and enhancing your overall productivity. 

But CC doesn't stop at transcription. We understand the importance of language diversity and inclusivity, which is why CC offers seamless translation capabilities. Effortlessly switch between languages and watch as CC translates the transcribed text into your preferred language in an instant, breaking down language barriers and fostering communication across borders. 

We value your privacy above all else. Unlike other transcription apps, CC does not collect or store any transcriptions or translations. Your data remains secure and private, giving you peace of mind as you utilize CC for your personal and professional needs.
In addition to its powerful transcription and translation features, CC boasts a user-friendly interface that is intuitive and easy to navigate. Whether you're a seasoned user or new to transcription tools, CC's simple yet sophisticated design ensures a seamless experience for all.

Hope you enjoy our take on the future of audio transcription and translation on Apple Vision.

Languages that can be translated from CC include, but not limited to: French, Spanish, German, Turkish, Arabic, Chinese (Mandarin), Korean and many more!

record.description_evidence:
The Only Haitian Creole Translator with Real AI Voices — Voice In, Voice Out

Speak in English or Creole. Hear the translation back in a natural AI voice that sounds nothing like a robot. Creole Translator is the only app that accepts your voice as input AND delivers AI-generated voice output in both Haitian Creole and English. Every other Haitian Creole translation app offers text-in, text-out. This one speaks back.

How it works:
1. Tap the microphone and speak naturally
2. Your speech is transcribed in real time
3. An accurate AI translation appears instantly
4. Hear it spoken back in a natural AI voice — automatically

Key Features:

• Voice-to-voice translation — The only Haitian Creole app with real voice input AND natural voice output; no typing, no reading required
• Offline Phrasebook — Common phrases for greetings, travel, medical care, directions, and emergencies, ready instantly with no internet connection needed
• Favorites — Star any translation in your history to keep it permanently, even as your history grows
• Natural AI voices — Powered by Groq Orpheus (English) and OpenAI (Creole) for expressive, human-sounding speech — not computerized text-to-speech
• 12 voice choices — 6 English voices (Autumn, Diana, Hannah, Austin, Daniel, Troy) and 6 Creole voices (Alloy, Echo, Fable, Onyx, Nova, Shimmer); extra voices unlock free for 24 hours by watching a short optional ad
• Playback speed control — Adjust from 0.5× to 1.5× — ideal for language learners, medical staff, or noisy environments
• Two-way translation — Switch between Haitian Creole → English or English → Haitian Creole with one tap
• Text input mode — Type when you can't speak; great for quiet settings, meetings, or accessibility needs
• Translation history — Browse and replay all past translations with full audio playback
• AI-powered accuracy — Fast, contextually accurate translations
• Privacy controls — View the privacy policy or revoke AI data consent anytime in Settings
• Dark mode — Comfortable to use in any lighting

Built for people on the front lines of Haitian community service:

Healthcare workers — Hand your phone to a Haitian patient and let them hear the translation spoken aloud in natural-sounding Creole. No reading required. Perfect for hospitals, clinics, and emergency rooms.

Social workers, legal aid providers, educators, and community volunteers serving the Haitian diaspora across New York, Miami, Boston, and Orlando.

Language learners — Slow down playback to hear Creole at a comfortable pace as you build fluency.

This app is free and supported by advertising. Banner ads appear at the bottom of the screen, a full-screen ad may appear periodically between translations, and you can choose to watch an optional rewarded ad to unlock extra voices.

Requires an internet connection for AI translation and voice playback. The Phrasebook works fully offline.

record.description_evidence:
Break language barriers instantly with TranslatorAI — the smart, privacy-first translator built for travelers, students, and professionals.

TRANSLATE IN THREE WAYS
• Type or paste any text for instant AI translation
• Speak naturally — voice recognition converts speech to translated text in real time
• Point your camera at signs, menus, or documents — OCR extracts and translates text on the spot

CONVERSATION MODE
Face-to-face bilingual conversations made effortless. A split-screen interface lets you and another person speak in your own languages, with translations appearing on each side — no passing a phone back and forth.

SMART PHRASE BOOK
Save your favorite translations, organize them into categories (Travel, Business, Daily Life, Custom), and export them for offline reference. Never search for the same phrase twice.

HISTORY & STATS
Every translation is stored locally on your device. Browse, search, and favorite past translations. Track your language learning progress with built-in usage statistics.

DAILY PHRASES
Start each day with a set of AI-curated phrases tailored to your learning goal — education, travel, research, or business. A home screen widget keeps today's phrase one glance away.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
Your translations are never stored on our servers. All history and preferences live exclusively on your device using Apple's SwiftData framework. Translation requests are processed securely and not retained.

POWERED BY AI
Uses GPT-4.1-mini for high-quality, context-aware translations across 80+ language pairs — far beyond simple word substitution.

SYSTEM INTEGRATION
• Siri Shortcuts — "Translate [phrase] to Spanish"
• Share Extension — translate text from any app
• Home Screen Widget — daily phrase at a glance
• iOS 18 optimized

TRANSLATORAI PRO SUBSCRIPTION
TranslatorAI is free to download. Upgrade to TranslatorAI Pro to unlock our premium experience:
• Unlimited Translations: Enjoy unlimited text, voice, and camera (OCR) translations without any daily limits.

record.description_evidence:
BufferMind is a real-time transcription and translation app built for students learning in a language that is not their first. It listens to your lecture, transcribes every word, and translates it as the professor speaks — so you can follow along live, and actually understand it afterwards.

REAL-TIME TRANSCRIPTION
Fast, accurate speech-to-text across 15+ input languages including English, Chinese, Spanish, Hindi, Korean, Japanese, French and German, with an auto-detect mode for multilingual classrooms.

INSTANT TRANSLATION
Original and translation side by side as the lecture unfolds — Chinese, English, Hindi, Korean, Japanese and Spanish. You can also have the translation read aloud through your headphones while class is still running.

ANDY, YOUR AI TEACHING ASSISTANT
Ask Andy anything about a lecture you recorded and get an answer grounded in your own transcript, not the open internet. Snap a photo of a problem on the board and ask about that instead. Andy also catches the moment your name is called, so you do not miss it.

A HISTORY YOU CAN ACTUALLY USE
Every session keeps its transcript, translation and audio. Tap any word to jump to that exact second of the recording. Search across everything you have ever recorded. Group sessions into folders by course, and upload the syllabus so Andy knows what the class is about.

LIVE ACTIVITY
An active recording stays visible on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, so you can confirm it is still running without unlocking your phone.

TALKING TO PEOPLE
Push-to-talk translated conversation for talking to someone face to face — Chinese, English, Cantonese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish and Hindi. Add friends to share sessions, chat with text, photos, video and voice messages, or start a voice or video call.

TRY IT WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Tap "Continue as Guest" and start recording, transcribing and translating immediately — no email, no signup. Guest sessions are capped at 10 minutes each. Sign in with Apple, Google, LINE or email to lift that cap, sync across your devices, and unlock Andy, friends and chat.

PLANS
BufferMind is free to start: creating an account gives you a monthly allowance of recording and AI usage at no charge. When you need more, Pro and Max are available as auto-renewing subscriptions.
• Pro — US$9.99 per month, or US$19.99 every 3 months
• Max — US$19.99 per month, or US$49.99 every 3 months
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of that period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew in your Apple Account settings after purchase.

PRIVACY
Audio streams to our speech-to-text provider (Soniox) only while you are recording, and is not retained on their side once the session ends. Your recordings, transcripts and translations live in your own private BufferMind account. Delete any single session — or your entire account and everything in it — at any time from Settings. We do not track you and we do not sell your data.

COMMUNITY GUIDELINES
Chat and calls only happen between people who have accepted each other as friends, and you can remove a friend at any time. We have zero tolerance for abusive or objectionable content: press and hold any message to report it, and we review every report.
